reference.title: Timing and energy stability of resonant dispersive wave emission in gas-filled hollow-core waveguides
reference.gas_sellmeier_ref: Boerzsoenyi et al., Appl. Opt. 47, 4856 (2008) [paper ref 23]

accept_tolerances.arrival_time_jitter: absolute; hard assert < 300 as over the paper's parameter scans (Fig. 5 text)
accept_tolerances.energy_noise_trend: trend-level (noise suppression at saturation vs amplification at low energy), tolerance stated per scan
accept_tolerances.simple_model_jitter: Eq. (11) model vs simulated jitter: factor-2 (paper 'closely reproduces')
accept_tolerances.compression_length: fission/compression length within ~20 % of the paper's white-dashed-line criterion (their Sec III B definition)

model.paper_model: carrier-resolved multi-mode UPPE, HE11-HE14, gas+waveguide dispersion (Marcatili-Schmeltzer capillary model), confinement loss, Kerr + photoionisation + plasma, THG on
model.reproduction_model: single-mode (HE11) GNLSE-layer: pressure-scaled gas dispersion + capillary waveguide dispersion/loss, Kerr (+ self-steepening), Raman off (noble gas), NO photoionisation/plasma in v1 (recorded out-of-scope; the paper itself runs plasma-free comparisons)

ions.THG: OUT OF SCOPE v1 (belt at 100-3 um wavelengths; RDW band unaffected structurally)

model.integrator: engine SplitStepEngine/RK4IP (paper: adaptive Dormand-Prince 4(5) in the interaction picture)

waveguides.name: hcf_125um
waveguides.radius_source: paper text '125 um core radius' (Fig. 1 and everywhere)
waveguides.loss_anchor_note: paper Fig. 8 text: transmission ~87 % at 800 nm; use as the Marcatili-loss sanity check

waveguides.type: hollow-core PCF (scaled-down small-core variant, paper Fig. 8)
waveguides.scaling-law: pressure scales with a^-2 (with helium EOS corrections, paper text)

gas.sellmeier: Boerzsoenyi 2008 inert-gas fits (paper ref 23), scaled via pressure-dependent number density (CoolProp EOS, ref 24)
gas.qualitative_wavelength_trend: higher pressure -> longer RDW wavelength (paper abstract & Fig. 2 caption)

pump.shape: transform-limited Gaussian (sech2 for the fission-length formula Eq. 12)

resampling_method.probe_energies: 800 uniformly spaced pump energies over the scan range
resampling_method.interpolant: RDW energy/arrival-time/wavelength interpolants over pump energy (and duration for the Fig. 7 study)

direct_method.note: resampling validated against direct sampling (paper Fig. 2c/d); our ensemble uses direct/resampled approach per runtime budget (herdr background, batched)

rdw_extraction.variable_window: 15 % relative bandwidth centred on the RDW band (Fig. 3+)
rdw_extraction.arrival_time: IFFT of the filtered frequency-domain field -> first moment (centre of mass)
rdw_extraction.rdw_energy: integrated filtered spectral energy density, summed over modes (single mode here)
rdw_extraction.central_wavelength_jitter: first moment of the filtered spectrum
rdw_extraction.grid_note: paper grid: 100 nm - 3 um, 450 fs window, 4096 samples; our engine grid chosen to resolve the RDW band + pump (dt <= 55 as equivalent)

simple_model.validation_target: reproduces the simulated jitter magnitude (paper Fig. 6)

fig1.system: 125 um / 1 m / 2.1 bar He / 225 uJ / 7.5 fs / 800 nm
fig1.status: v1 target: reproduce the compression optimum + RDW spectrum position (within phase_matching tolerance)

fig2.scan: constant pressures, energies 110-210 uJ, RDW tuneability window
fig2.status: v1: RDW central wavelength vs phase-matching root at the compression point per pressure

fig3.energy_noise: amplified at low pump energy; suppressed below the pumps own noise once saturated; gradient case suppresses to ~0

fig5.proportionality: jitter proportional to pump-energy noise over the full range
fig5.plasma_note: 0.8-bar exceptional stability needs plasma -> out of scope v1

anchors.fig7: 1 % duration noise gives similar-order timing jitter despite smaller relative noise (fission length sensitivity)

fig8.trend: same noise characteristics when loss is switched off; the 1 m HCF transmission ~87 % explains the residual difference
fig8.status: v1: reproduce the scaled pairs at no-loss setting (confinement loss optional toggle)

anchors.fig6: Eq. (11) simple group-velocity/fission-length model reproduces jitter magnitude

engine_stack.linear_step: pressure-scaled He Sellmeier + Marcatili-Schmeltzer capillary beta(omega) & confinement loss alpha(omega) via TaperedGNLSESolver dispersion_profile(beta(w, z)) or loss hooks
steps_to_audit: engine supports per-frequency loss (alpha(omega)) - check FiberProfile/GNLSESolver hooks
gamma of the gas-filled capillary: gamma0 = n2_He * omega0 / (c * Aeff) with Aeff ~ pi a^2 (capillary correction optional v1)

runtime_notes.deterministic_single_run: TBD once the first engine compression run is timed (record here per house rule)
runtime_notes.ensemble: shard direct-sampling ensembles across herdr panes; resampling interpolants are cheap once the probe-scan is done
